items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: he said go over there and hear Brother Cullenbrack, I think he called you.

ctx.x: Well, that was when I was playing at the H and J Tavern. Now, it was during the war, World War II I believe.
I think I first heard you, I was staying with George Lewis one summer for about a month and he said go over there and hear Brother Cullenbrack, I think he called you. Yeah.
At that time. Uh, where I was then.
